createdecals.ponder.decal_block.text_1: A Decal Block is a full copycat block, for hulls built of whole blocks
createdecals.ponder.decal_block.text_2: Each of its faces takes a decal of its own: the stencil puts it on the face you click
createdecals.ponder.decal_block.text_3: Faces against a solid block are hidden, decal and all, as on any block
createdecals.ponder.decal_block.text_4: Set the stencil to the front layer to put a second decal over the first, such as a number on a stripe
createdecals.ponder.decal_block.text_5: A Glow Ink Sac makes a decal glow in the dark; an Ink Sac stops it
createdecals.ponder.decal_panel.header: Putting a decal on a Decal Panel
createdecals.ponder.decal_panel.text_1: A Decal Panel is a Copycat Panel that can show a decal on its front
createdecals.ponder.decal_panel.text_2: Like any copycat, it takes the look of a block used on it
createdecals.ponder.decal_panel.text_3: Right-click it with a Decal Stencil to put the stencil's decal on it. Create's own Copycat Panels turn into Decal Panels the same way
createdecals.ponder.decal_panel.text_5: The decal is part of the block: it stays on trains, contraptions and Sable vehicles, and under shaders
createdecals.ponder.decal_stencil.header: Choosing, placing and picking up decals
createdecals.ponder.decal_stencil.text_1: Use the Decal Stencil in the air to choose a decal or type a word, its colour, and how it is turned and flipped
createdecals.ponder.decal_stencil.text_2: Decals larger than one block spread right and down from the face you click, over the decal blocks beside it
createdecals.ponder.decal_stencil.text_3: Sneak and right-click a decal to pick it up into the stencil, then use it elsewhere
createdecals.ponder.decal_stencil.text_4: The stencil's eraser takes a whole decal off, clicked on any of its tiles. Create's Clipboard copies decals too
createdecals.ponder.decal_stencil_deploy: A Deployer holding a Decal Stencil stamps its decal on the block in front of it, as a player's click does
With a dye it recolours the decal; with the stencil's eraser it takes the decal off
Carried on a contraption, a Deployer stamps every block it passes: lay a stripe along a hull as it goes by
createdecals.ponder.decal_step.text_1: A Decal Step is a Copycat Step that takes a decal on any of its faces
createdecals.ponder.decal_step.text_2: Each face shows the part of the decal it covers, as if the decal lay on the whole face of the block, so stripes and patterns run on from the Decal Blocks beside it
createdecals.ponder.decal_step.text_3: Letters and numbers read best on Decal Blocks and Panels, where the whole decal shows
createdecals.ponder.decal_step.text_4: Create's own Copycat Steps turn into Decal Steps when a stencil puts a decal on them
createdecals.ponder.tag.decals.descripti: Liveries for anything Create builds: decals on copycat blocks
createdecals.stencil.front_only: A Decal Panel takes a decal on its front only
createdecals.stencil.layer_back: Back layer: goes under a front decal; picks up and erases back decals
createdecals.stencil.layer_front: Front layer: goes over the decal already there; picks up and erases front decals
createdecals.stencil.no_decal: Choose a decal first: use the stencil in the air
createdecals.stencil.partly: Only %s of %s tiles landed: the rest are not on decal blocks, or are protected
createdecals.stencil.title: Decal Stencil
createdecals.stencil.undone_partly: Undone: %s of %s tiles (the rest were changed since, or are protected)
createdecals.stencil.wrong_block: %s takes no decals: use Decal Blocks, Panels or Steps

Puts _decals_ or a typed _word_ on Decal Panels, Blocks and Steps, behind or in front of the decal already there; Create's Copycat Panels and Steps become decal ones when they take one. Choose in its screen.
